name: Broadway Barrels LLC
description: Broadway Barrels is a vibrant karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and diverse entertainment options. It offers a classy lounge environment with comfortable seating, a top-notch sound system, and a large song selection that caters to various tastes. The venue hosts karaoke, live music, trivia nights, and open mic events, making it a lively spot for both casual and enthusiastic performers. Friendly staff, a great vibe, and the option to bring your own food or enjoy nearby food trucks make Broadway Barrels a must-visit for karaoke lovers in Lawrenceburg.
